title.zh: Ether is about to lose a steady buyer as Tom Lee says Bitmine will stop token purchases
title.en: Ether is about to lose a steady buyer as Tom Lee says Bitmine will stop token purchases

current_state.zh: Tom Lee said Bitmine will stop buying ether once it holds 5% of the token's supply, ending an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.
current_state.en: Tom Lee said Bitmine will stop buying ether once it holds 5% of the token's supply, ending an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.
